data.long_meaning: In Greek, Jecho means 'God is healer'. This name is rooted in the belief that God is the ultimate source of healing and restoration. In the Bible, Jecho is not found as a personal name, but it is mentioned in the Old Testament as the name of a town in Judah. The name Jecho carries the meaning “God is healer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jecho usually hope their child will grow to embody god is healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
